subject: Medford Little League Opening Day Ceremony
overview: The City of Medford held its annual Little League opening day ceremony, featuring a parade of teams, recitation of league pledges, and ceremonial first pitches.

items.title: Parade and Team Assembly
items.summary: Coaches and youth players from various local teams gathered for the annual parade and team assembly.

items.title: National Anthem
items.summary: Renee and Kara Messerschmitt performed the national anthem to open the formal ceremony.

items.title: Recitation of Pledges
items.summary: Participants recited the Little League pledge followed by the coach's pledge, which emphasizes positive reinforcement and team culture.

items.title: Mayor's Remarks and Ceremonial First Pitches
items.summary: Mayor Stephanie Muccini Burke addressed the families and players before city officials threw ceremonial first pitches to start the season.
